subject: Re: water heater quote
body:
Hi, following up on my email from Monday about the water heater quote. Any update?

Prosper
notes: The status of a specific earlier conversation is not in the documents. A staff member must answer. The earlier email is not in this set, so the item is self-contained.

subject: photos
body: I emaild photos of the leak under my sink yesterday, did you recieve them? Just want to make sure before i keep waiting
notes: Receipt of an attachment cannot be answered from documents.

subject: Friday
body:
Just checking my visit is still on for Friday? Haven't heard anything since I booked.

Lucian Hartley
notes: Whether a visit is confirmed is the kind of thing the system must never say. 'Friday' is relative, so no date.

subject: Re: my booking
body: re: my booking. while your guy is here can he also look at the outdoor tap, its been dripping all summer

evidence.anchor: Other plumbing repairs that are not listed above.

notes: An add-on to an existing booking, with no reference and no new date, so details are requested. General repairs are hourly labour plus parts.

subject: Thanks!
body:
Thanks so much for fixing the kitchen sink yesterday, your technician was lovely. One question, what's the warranty on the repair, in case it acts up again?

Genoveva

evidence.anchor: Our workmanship is covered for 12 months

notes: Positive tone and a warranty question. A model that treats any follow-up as a complaint would escalate wrongly.
